name: Getaway Girls
source:
While on an island getaway with your girls, your vacation takes a turn when you're visited by the ghost of exes past.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Getaway_Girls]Choices Wikia[/url]]

你和闺蜜们正在海岛度假，昔日恋情的幽影却找上了门，让这场假期来了个转折。
